hypothesis: H-C03-4: 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s is non-terminating iff (a) r >= 2q and s >= 2p, or (b) s >= 2p, q < r < 2q and p | s, or (c) r >= 2q, p < s < 2p and q | r; otherwise it terminates. Mechanism for (b): every rule (1, q, r, k) with q < r < 2q, k >= 2 loops, and the morphism 0 -> 0^p maps it onto (p, q, r, kp).
